answer: Stake-escrowed competitive task-bidding with forfeiture: every job is a sealed auction where each bidder escrows a live performance bond beside its bid, burned if the winner fails verified delivery. A sybil operator cannot field a hundred identities for free, each needs its own bond posted at once, so the swarm teeters on a narrow ledge of locked capital. Fakes that win but cannot do the work forfeit their escrow, bleeding it like an umber dust tail behind a comet until the operation is priced out. Honest agents reclaim the bond on delivery, only non-performers pay.
